title: AttestArc learning candidate
description: A proposed improvement to AttestArc itself, produced by the Evolver (a dev-time, PR-gated principal). A LearningCandidate is a PROPOSAL, never an applied change: it names what to change and why, and MUST be reviewed and merged through the normal PR + eval gate before it affects anything. It never modifies the running kernel. Secrets and private repository content MUST NOT appear anywhere in a candidate; learning defaults to local-only. Candidates are development scaffolding under evolution/ and are NOT shipped in the skill payload.

type.description: What kind of gap the candidate addresses.

change_target.description: Which trust zone the change lands in. 'knowledge': a signed pack entry (data). 'reference': durable domain methodology. 'helper': a deterministic script. 'methodology': the kernel — highest-scrutiny, two-party review.

summary.description: One-line statement of the proposed change. No verdict about any specific repository; no secret values.

rationale.description: Why the change is warranted, in terms of a reasoning gap — not a specific private finding.

observation.description: The sanitized, generalized observation that motivated the candidate. MUST be scrubbed of secrets and private repository content.

proposed_change.description: Concrete proposed edit (a knowledge entry, a reference paragraph, a helper behavior, or a methodology clause). Applied only after review.

security_regression_direction.description: Does adopting the candidate increase scrutiny (positive), keep it the same (neutral), or make a previously-flagged pattern look safe (negative)? Negative is the shape of a poisoning attempt and always requires human review.

origin.description: Where the learning came from. Never carries the raw private context.

kind.description: The corpus role. A candidate SHOULD add a find/refuse pair; it MUST NOT weaken or delete a trusted eval.

paired_evals.description: Paired evals the candidate proposes to ADD. Additive only — deletions/weakenings are two-party review (see core/promotion-policy.md).

status.description: Lifecycle. A candidate is only ever advanced by review, never by the running assessor.

extensions.description: Open namespace for tool-specific data. Secret values MUST NOT appear here.
